text: No, I don't want CF card storage. Like I said, the only thing changing needs to be the zoom. I want the maximum zoom, but with the same 24MP resolution and SD card storage. That's what I asked for. This isn't working. Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
zh: 不，我不想用 CF 卡存储。就像我说的，唯一需要改变的是变焦。我想最大变焦，但保持 24MP 分辨率和 SD 卡存储。这就是我要求的。这行不通。我能和能真正解决这个问题的人谈谈吗？
